pages.en:
“What——is that?”

She has circled the temple grounds and reached the pond.

There, Saber finds an enormous mass of flesh.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“What is that?”
The first thing Saber sees after getting to the lake is a giant mountain of meat.

pages.ja:
彼女とて並みの騎士ではない。
英雄と呼ばれていた時代、様々な幻想種と戦う事も少なくはなかった。
最強の幻想種と謳われる『竜種』とさえ、剣を合わせた事もある。
その彼女が、あの肉塊には怯むしかなかった。
醜さからではない。
あのカタチ
あの肉塊から放たれる呪いと、あの肉塊そのものが、自分と同じだと直感した為に。

pages.en:
She is no ordinary knight.

In the age when she was hailed as a hero, she often fought the monsters known as Phantasmal Species.

She has even crossed swords with dragonkind, acclaimed as the mightiest among them.

And yet the mass of flesh makes her recoil.

Not because of its ugliness.

Because instinct tells her that its form——the curse radiating from that flesh, and the flesh itself——is the same as what she is.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She is not a normal knight.
She fought many monsters back when she was called a hero.
She has even fought “dragons”, considered the strongest of the fantasy races.
But even Saber falters against the mountain of meat.
It is not because of its ugliness.
It is because she can tell that the lump of meat and the curse flowing out of it are the same as her.

召喚を間違えれば、サーヴァントとはあそこまで変わるものなのか」
それとも、それが聖杯の力なのか。
彼女は呆然と肉塊を見据え、咄嗟にかぶりをふった。

pages.en:
“A Servant——can a mistake in the summoning transform one so completely?”

Or is this the power of the Holy Grail?

She stares at the flesh in disbelief, then abruptly shakes herself free of it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“A Servantcan a Servant turn out to be that different if the summoning is done in the wrong way?”
Or is that the power of the Holy Grail?
She stares at it and shakes her head.

池に駆け寄り、対岸の肉塊に声を上げる。
池の中、黒い泥に足を入れる事は躊躇われた。
不快だからではない。
半霊体であるサーヴァントは、コレに触れてはならないと彼女の予知が告げているのだ。

pages.en:
“Rin…! Where are you, Rin…!?”

She rushes to the pond and calls out to the mass on the opposite shore.

She hesitates to set foot in the black mud filling the water.

Not because it repulses her.

Some premonition warns her that a Servant——a being half-composed of spirit——must never touch it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Rin…! Where are you, Rin…!?”
She runs to the lake and yells to the other side.
She is hesitant to enter the black mud.
It is not because it would be unpleasant.
Her instincts tell her that as a half-spirit, she cannot touch it.

！？」

「凛……！？」

pages.en:
“——!?”

A voice calls to her.

Faint but unmistakable, an order from her Master reaches her.

She narrows her eyes, searching the mass of flesh——

“Rin…!?”

and at the sight of what lies within, steps forward without hesitation.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“!?”
She hears a voice.
It is weak, but she hears her Master.
She looks at the mountain of meat and
“Rin……!?”
She steps forward without hesitation.

待った……！ ダメ、セイバーは入ってこないで……！』
「っ……！」
セイバーの体が止まる。
踏みだしかけた足を引き、彼女は剣を構えたままで肉塊を凝視する。

pages.en:
“——Wait…! No, Saber, don't come in here…!”

“——!”

Saber's body stops.

She draws back the foot poised above the mud and stares at the flesh, sword still ready.
pages.mirrorMoon:
‘Hold on…! No, don’t come in, Saber…!’
“……!”
Saber stops.
She stops her feet and glares at the mountain of meat while holding up her sword.

pages.ja:
「凛、ですが……！」
『いいからダメ……！ その泥に触れたら貴女だってこうなるわよ。いいから、セイバーはそこで宝具の準備をして。この塊はもうすぐ弾けるわ。その前に宝具でぶった斬っちゃって……！』
緊迫した主の声に、セイバーは頷く事が出来ない。
……あの肉塊が羽化しようとしているのは判る。
蠢動は鼓動に変わり、がふり、と吐き出す泥の量は増え続けている。

pages.en:
“Rin, but——!”

“Just don't…! If you touch that mud, you'll become like this too. Stay where you are and prepare your Noble Phantasm. This mass is about to burst. Cut it apart before it can…!”

The urgency in her Master's voice makes it impossible for Saber to agree.

…She can see that the mass is preparing to hatch.

Its writhing has become a heartbeat, and with every wet convulsion it disgorges still more black mud.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“But Rin…!”
‘Just don’t…! You’ll turn into this if you touch the mud. Please stay there and get ready to use your Noble Phantasm. This thing will explode soon. Use your Noble Phantasm on this before that…!’
Saber cannot nod to her master’s words.
…She can tell that the lump of meat is about to hatch.
The squirms are turning into throbs and the mud is spreading ever further.

……つまり、成長しているのだ。
あんなものをこのままにしておけば、それこそ抑止力が発動する。
その前に聖剣を以って破壊するのは当然だ。
だが
それには。
「凛、外に！ 池にさえ出てしまえば、あとは私が
！」

pages.en:
The pond is black with filth, and the mud has begun to spill across the ground.

…It is growing.

If something like this is left alone, the Counter Force itself will surely intervene.

Of course it must be destroyed with the holy sword before that happens.

But to do that——

“Rin, come out! Once you reach the pond, I can——!”
pages.mirrorMoon:
The lake has turned black, and the mud is spilling onto the ground.
…That thing is growing.
The world’s restraining power will be activated if that thing is left alone.
It is natural for her to destroy it with her holy sword.
But to do that
“Please get out, Rin…! I can do it once you get out!”

」

pages.en:
“…I know. All right, I'll leave it to you. But if I don't make it in time, save what you still can.

“…Our contract will be severed, but as long as Shirou survives, he'll manage somehow.”

“Do not speak such nonsense…! I don't care what it turns me into. A curse like this can be scattered——”

Saber tries to charge through the black mud toward the flesh.

But her body will not obey.

The moment she attempts to approach the pond, she is brought to a halt.
pages.mirrorMoon:
‘…Yeah. All right, I’ll leave it to you. But go ahead and use it if I don’t make it out on time.
…The contract between us will go away, but you should be fine if Shirou is alive.’
“Do not say such a thing…! I do not care. I can handle this curse”
Saber runs to the black mud so she can get to that lump of meat.
But her body does not move.
Her body stops when she tries to go near the lake.

“Rin, your Command Spell——”

“…Of course. I can't simply let the one person capable of destroying the Holy Grail throw her life away.

“And stop worrying. Something like this is nothing. I'll break free and escape without any trouble. Stay there, ready the holy sword, and trust me to handle the rest.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Rin, did you use the Command Spell?”
‘…Of course. I can’t let the only one who can destroy the Holy Grail die.
I told you it’s all good. I’ll easily get out from here. You can rest assured and stand by with your Noble Phantasm.’

“——Rin.”

But there is no need to say that it is a bluff.

The mass of flesh on the opposite shore——

the Master trapped within it lost every avenue of escape long ago.
pages.mirrorMoon:
She sounds calm and composed, like always.
“Rin.”
But it does not need to be said that it is just a bluff.
The island of meat on the other side…
There is nowhere for her Master to run.

なんてね。まあ、言うは易しってヤツだけど」
奇怪な肉の腕に囲まれながら、ぽつりと彼女は呟いた。
状況は、一言で言えばお話にならない。
間桐慎二は救えた。

いや、気を失って昏倒する姿は、彼を担いでいる彼女より健康とも言えた。

pages.en:
“——Or so I say. Easy to say, anyway.”

Surrounded by grotesque arms of flesh, she murmurs to herself.

——In a word, the situation is hopeless.

She managed to save Shinji Matou.

…She tore away the blood vessels and nerves fused throughout his body and dragged him bodily from the mass.

If one overlooks the inevitable aftereffects, he is sufficiently alive.

Indeed, unconscious in her arms, he might almost be healthier than the girl carrying him.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yeah, right. Well, talk is cheap.”
She murmurs while being surrounded by arms made out of the meat.
The situation is hopeless.
Matou Shinji was saved.
…She ripped off the blood vessels and nerves connected to the meat to let Shinji out.
One can say he’s “alive”, ignoring all the after-effects he may have.
No, he looks like he is just unconscious, so one could say that he is healthier than the girl carrying him.

巻き付き、肉塊に取り込もうとする触手たちをやりすごしたところで、壁と化したアレは突破できないだろう。

pages.en:
“…The problem came afterward. I suppose anything would lash out if someone stole its heart. Think this thing will let us go if I give Shinji back?”

Watching the tentacles that block her way, she inches toward the outside.

But there is no exit.

The route back to the pond is already webbed over with tentacles.

Even if she evades the limbs seeking to seize and absorb her, she cannot break through the wall they have formed.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…The problem is after that. I guess it would be desperate if it gets its heart taken away. Will it let me go if I give Shinji back?”
She slowly moves while she stares at the tentacles blocking her way.
But there is no exit.
The tentacles are blocking the way out to the lake.
Even if she escapes the tentacles trying to swallow her, she will not be able to get past that wall.

“Kh… First, I need… strength…”

She nearly collapses beneath Shinji Matou's weight and fights to remain upright.

She crossed the sea of curses to reach the island of flesh, then performed surgery upon its nerves to separate Shinji Matou from it.

By that point, she had already begun drawing upon reserves she had not touched in years——

“……Crap, my powers…”
She almost falls along with Shinji, but she desperately keeps herself up.
She went through the cursed sea and even performed neurosurgery to separate Matou Shinji from the mountain of meat.
She went as far as using her reserve magical energy that she hadn’t used for ages, but

目眩を堪えて、そんな文句を言ってみる。

pages.en:
“…Kh… That idiot. He takes my magical energy without the slightest restraint. …Thanks to him, I'm completely empty…”

She endures the dizziness and voices the complaint.

There is no anger behind it. She merely wanted to say the words.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Guh… That idiot. He took too much of my magical energy without any reserve. …I’m all empty now thanks to him…”
She bears the dizziness as she complains.
But she’s not serious.

pages.ja:
それに、魔力が残っていたところで変わらないのだ。
彼女を取り囲む触手たちは、獲物が大人しいからこそ停止している。
体内に侵入したモノが毒と判れば、即座に行動に移るだろう。
遠坂凛と間桐慎二が無事なのは、彼女にエサとしての魔力が残っていなかったからである。

pages.en:
Besides, retaining her magical energy would not have changed anything.

The tentacles surrounding her remain still only because their prey is docile.

The instant they recognize what has entered them as poison, they will act.

Rin Tohsaka and Shinji Matou remain unharmed only because she has no magical energy left to offer as food.
pages.mirrorMoon:
And it wouldn’t matter even if she did have more power.
The tentacles around her are not moving because their target is standing still.
They should react right away once they find out that the thing in their body is poison.
Tohsaka Rin and Matou Shinji are alive because they do not have magical energy to be consumed.

」
視界が霞む。
足場があるとは言え、ここも泥の上である事は変わらない。
彼女の神経は秒単位で熱に侵されている。
そうして肉の台地に倒れ込めば、ずぶずぶと音をたてて、今度は彼女自身が聖杯の核となるだろう。

pages.en:
“…Kh… But this may be… the end. Even standing is becoming… difficult——”

Her vision clouds.

There may be solid ground beneath her feet, but she is still standing atop the mud.

Its heat invades her nerves with every passing second.

If she collapses upon the plateau of flesh, she will sink into it with a wet sound——and this time, she herself will become the core of the Holy Grail.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……! …But I guess this is it… It’s getting hard for me to stay standing”
Her vision becomes hazy.
Even though she has a foothold, she is still on the mud.
Her nerves are getting further infiltrated with each passing second.
She will become the new core of the Holy Grail if she falls down onto the meat.

pages.en:
——Before that can happen——

“…I'm sorry, Saber. I know you won't listen, so I'll make you.”

One Command Spell remains.

That alone is enough to force Saber, waiting on the opposite shore, to wield the holy sword.
pages.mirrorMoon:
But before that…
“…I’m sorry, Saber. You probably won’t obey me, so I’ll force you to do it.”
She has one more Command Spell.
That’s enough for her to order Saber to use her holy sword.

That voice.

The thought reaches not her ears but her mind. Had it not come, unmistakably, from the Servant once bound to her?
pages.mirrorMoon:

She stops her collapsing body.
That voice.
The voice coming into her head is definitely that of the Servant she has made a contract with.

He told her to run, so he must have done something that she won’t escape unless she does as she’s told!

She runs.
The arrows coming down from the sky are literally a heavy rain.
They destroy the tentacles, the ground, and everything in her path!

pages.en:
“Saber, please——!”

Her cry is caught and carried by her magical energy.

There is no longer any need to confirm it.

The golden sword sweeps upward and, with overwhelming force, annihilates everything before it.

The mountain of flesh is severed and collapses.

The black mud evaporates, and the band of light transforms the pond itself into a perfectly level wasteland.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Please, Saber…!”
Her magical energy replies to the yelling voice.
There is no need to check.
The golden sword mows down everything in its path with its overwhelming power.
The mountain of meat is cut in half and breaks down.
The black mud evaporates, and the light turns the lake into a flat field.
